integrity: Analytical proof given with a standalone numerical consistency checker; the experimental tests are not universal proofs. Literature priority remains conditional on inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Real geodesic Lipschitz seminorm on the circumference-2pi circle, \(0<\alpha\le1\) and fixed alpha asymptotics; does not classify anisotropic/higher-dimensional kernels or variable alpha. Prior Brownian endpoint and Poisson special cases are known.
title: A sharp Lipschitz phase transition for fractional heat on the circle
